"rationale": "GBW 26 MHz into 0.5 pF needs gm1 >= 82 uS. M1 biased at Vgs = 0.75 V gives about 195 uS from 15 uA. The f3db and GBW specs together cap the gain near 1000, so the cascode Rout is shunted by R to a replica node. That fixes the gain at about 550 (54.8 dB). A 1/4-scale replica, gated by an internal 0.75 V divider, sets the PMOS load gate and makes vout_dc equal vrep (about 0.75 V). Budget: 18.75 uA core, 1 uA divider and assumed 10 uA IREF, about 54 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "I1":    (15e-6, 8e-6, 22e-6),    # main branch current
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),         # input device L
    "gmid2": (12, 8, 18), "L2": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),   # NMOS cascode
    "gmid3": (12, 8, 15), "L3": (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),   # PMOS cascode
    "gmid4": (11, 7, 14), "L4": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),   # PMOS load
    "Atgt":  (550, 400, 900),         # target low-frequency gain (V/V)
    "vds1":  (0.25, 0.18, 0.35),      # M1 drain voltage
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75); CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    k = 4                              # main : replica current ratio
    I1 = p["I1"]; Ir = I1 / k
    vds1 = p["vds1"]; vsd4 = 0.25

    # M1: Vgs is set by vin_dc. Size W from the forward model.
    o = lut.op("n", 10.0, p["L1"], vin, vds1)
    W1 = 10.0 * I1 / o["Id"]
    gm1 = o["gm"] * I1 / o["Id"]; gds1 = o["gds"] * I1 / o["Id"]

    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], I1, vds=vsd4)
    vrep = VDD - m4.vgs                       # vout DC = replica node
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I1, vds=max(vrep - vds1, 0.2), vsb=vds1)
    vcn = vds1 + m2.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=max(VDD - vsd4 - vrep, 0.2), vsb=vsd4)
    vcp = VDD - vsd4 - m3.vgs
    m2r = lut.size("n", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], Ir, vds=max(vrep - vds1, 0.2), vsb=vds1)
    m3r = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Ir, vds=max(VDD - vsd4 - vrep, 0.2), vsb=vsd4)
    m4r = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], Ir, vds=vsd4)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # main branch
    n.M("M1", "x1", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, p["L1"])
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vcn", "x1", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vcp", "y1", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y1", "vrep", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    # replica branch at 1/k scale (low-voltage-cascode diode)
    n.M("M1R", "x2", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1 / k, p["L1"])
    n.dev("M2R", "vrep", "vcn", "x2", "vss", m2r)
    n.dev("M3R", "vrep", "vcp", "y2", "vdd", m3r)
    n.dev("M4R", "y2", "vrep", "vdd", "vdd", m4r)

    # Resistive bias string generating vref = vin_dc, vcn and vcp (1 uA)
    Idiv = 1e-6
    taps = sorted([("vcn", vcn), ("vref", vin), ("vcp", vcp)], key=lambda t: -t[1])
    prev_node, prev_v = "vdd", VDD
    for i, (nm, v) in enumerate(taps):
        n.R("RD%d" % i, prev_node, nm, max((prev_v - v) / Idiv, 1e3))
        prev_node, prev_v = nm, v
    n.R("RD3", prev_node, "vss", max(prev_v / Idiv, 1e3))

    # IREF sink: diode-connected nfet
    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    # Gain-setting resistor vout -> vrep (no DC current; vrep feedback amplifies its conductance by 1+k)
    Rn = gm1 / max(gds1, 1e-12) / max(m2.gds, 1e-12) * m2.gm / gm1 if False else m2.gm / (gds1 * m2.gds)
    Rp = m3.gm / (m3.gds * m4.gds)
    gcas = 1 / Rn + 1 / Rp
    Rneed = p["Atgt"] / gm1
    gR = 1 / Rneed - gcas
    R = min(max((1 + k) / gR, 1e4), 1e9) if gR > 0 else 1e9
    n.R("RG", "vout", "vrep", R)

    gout = gcas + (1 + k) / R
    A = gm1 / gout
    Cout = CL + m2.cdd + m3.cdd + 5e-15
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cout)
    f3 = gbw / A
    power = VDD * (I1 + Ir + Idiv + iref)
    swing = max((VDD - vsd4 - m3.vdsat - 0.05) - (vds1 + m2.vdsat + 0.05), 0.0)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vrep, "swing": swing}
